what_to_report: Missingness per variable and overall, by outcome class and key subgroups; pattern (monotone/intermittent); number of complete cases.
Clinical reasons for missingness (who orders the test, when, why); assumed mechanism per key variable as an untestable assumption, with the variables that make MAR plausible.
Method, software and version, key settings (number of imputations, iterations, conditional models, seeds).
Variables and auxiliary variables used; outcome included when imputing development data; interactions/non-linear terms compatible with the analysis model.
How imputation uncertainty reaches estimates and predictions (Rubin's rules, pooled predictions, between-imputation spread).
Imputer fitted inside resampling on training folds only; performance on the downstream task (discrimination, calibration), not imputation error alone.
How missing predictors are handled when the model is applied to a new patient (real-time imputation, pattern submodels, indicators); performance when a predictor is systematically unavailable.
Missingness and performance across sociodemographic and clinical subgroups; mitigation applied.
Departures from MAR (delta-adjusted or pattern-mixture MI) or alternative handling; effect on conclusions.
Code, seeds, imputation models; data or synthetic surrogate where permitted.
